# Quantum Solver

## Abstract
This study evaluates whether a logistic regression model (StandardScaler + L2, C=1.0, lbfgs, max_iter=1000) outperforms a majority-class baseline on balanced test accuracy for the wine_quality dataset. Quantum methods are mentioned as background context only. The experiment uses a stratified 80/20 train-test split with seed=42 and measures performance using balanced accuracy.
## Conclusion
The logistic regression model (StandardScaler + L2, C=1.0, lbfgs, max_iter=1000) was evaluated against a majority-class baseline on the wine_quality dataset. [RESULT-1] Future work could explore quantum methods as alternative approaches.
